name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
summary: At Ratchet's pier, a crate of alchemy supplies waits for passage across the sea. Wharfmaster Dizzywig arranges its journey to the Old World aboard a ship bound for Blackwater Cove.

sections.title: A Courier to the Port
sections.body: A crate of potions and reagents waits at the Barrens port, bound for colleagues in the Old World. Caravans that might have carried it have already departed, so you are asked to take the secure shipment to Ratchet's water's edge. The port offers a route across the Great Sea between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

sections.title: Ratchet's Docks
sections.body: Wharfmaster Dizzywig handles cargo on Ratchet's wooden piers. He tracks shipments in ledgers and manifests, then finds space aboard vessels sailing east across the Great Sea. This crate is booked for a ship bound for Blackwater Cove.

faq.answer: Wharfmaster Dizzywig is the goblin harbor official on Ratchet's main pier. He manages ship manifests, cargo holds, and passages between Kalimdor and ports across the sea.

faq.q: Where is the crate being sent?
faq.answer: The crate of potions and reagents is bound for the Old World, aboard the next ship sailing from Ratchet to Blackwater Cove.
Ratchet lies on the eastern coast of the Barrens, in a sheltered bay directly east of the central crossroads.

faq.q: Why send cargo through a goblin port?
faq.answer: Ratchet is a neutral port open to Horde and independent traders. Its regular routes cross the Great Sea and avoid military blockades and political hostilities.

faq.q: What is inside the secure crate?
faq.answer: The secure crate holds prepared potions, crafting reagents, and other alchemical goods for associates in the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Who sends the shipment to Dizzywig?
faq.answer: An alchemical practitioner in the Barrens sent the shipment after missing the departing caravan. A reliable runner is needed to reach the pier before the next tide.

angles.text: As a Horde adventurer crossing the Barrens, you can carry cargo to Ratchet and learn the sea routes linking Kalimdor with the Eastern Kingdoms.
